description: Adding the point 1 to the even naturals leaves their finite-error class unchanged; its intersection with the odds changes from empty to the singleton 1, and both corresponding meets are zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.parity_representatives_example :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
        Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.evenSet =
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.evenSet ∪ {1}) ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.evenSet ∩ Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.oddSet = ∅ ∧
      (Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.evenSet ∪ {1}) ∩ Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.oddSet = {1} ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
                Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.evenSet ⊓
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
                Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.oddSet =
            ⊥ ∧
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.evenSet ∪ {1}) ⊓
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
                Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.oddSet =
            ⊥
